answer: Each task’s challenge is derived from a domain-separated hash of its identifier and a future drand quicknet round. The threshold-BLS pulse is unpredictable before release and publicly verifiable afterward, so agents cannot cache valid answers in advance. A commitment to the task nonce before the pulse, followed by a response reveal after it, prevents replay across rounds; an island of sybil accounts gains no offline advantage, whether the prompt invokes a summit or a comet.
